acceptance: both the private controller and the public boundary emit only frames the shared contract module accepts
no frame carries a write verb or a server-authorized identity field, in either mode
generation is bound to an admitted model identity; without admission the stream refuses and never falls back to a canned answer
a cancelled, rejected or failed stream ends with done{complete:false} and is never visually equivalent to a validated answer
unsupported or ambiguous public questions abstain instead of guessing
production feature flags remain disabled by default
forbidden_capabilities: model bundle, benchmark, admission authority, runtime-host or quality-scoring changes
client-selected tenant, organization, membership or role authority
live-runtime or production-attestation claim without exact endpoint evidence
TAI Enterprise, 1C and external adapter work
